2026-07-05.title: 48 commits, two build fronts, one very busy week.
highlights: Atrak Website and Hoops Highlights App moved in parallel instead of waiting on one another.
The website interaction pass landed while launch-readiness work continued across the highlights app.
shipped: A more reliable interactive Atrak website experience
Visible launch-readiness progress across Hoops Highlights App
engineering: The week combined frontend interaction work, Three.js hardening, Python services, and iOS release preparation.
Automated GitHub snapshots now preserve the underlying activity after the public event window expires.
fixes: Hardened desktop 3D startup and fallback behavior
Tightened launch and TestFlight readiness details
next: Keep the website fast while the visual system gets more ambitious.
Turn launch-readiness progress into a verifiable public milestone.
